news.title: My algorithm, ad-free sources, more video models, 16 formats
news.body: Make tab > My algorithm: connect your YouTube and get a batch of shorts (15 by default) from your own home feed and subscriptions. Sponsor reads are cut out of every download. Settings > Visuals adds Google Gemini and Higgsfield, plus backup models that take over when one runs out. Settings > Formats has 16 ready-made short formats (gameplay commentary, tutorial, top 3, myth vs fact...). Source clips can now run up to 10 s, 10 per short.

news.title: ClipForge has a launcher
news.body: Double-click ClipForge to open the studio, check that this PC has everything it needs, read what's new, and update with one button. Your shorts, channels and keys are never touched by an update.

news.title: Tune how your ElevenLabs voice performs
news.body: Settings > Voice now has delivery presets (Creator energy, Hyped, Calm narrator, Deadpan, Storyteller) and sliders for stability, style, similarity and pace, saved per channel. Preview a style before you save it.
